# ViraStack Guide

> Interactive walkthrough from plain semantic content to an AI-assisted interface, then into the ViraStack ecosystem. Site experience at virastack.com — not an npm package.

Play the guide: https://virastack.com/guide/play — Landing: https://virastack.com/guide

For step-by-step narrative and stack notes, prefer [llms-full.txt](https://virastack.com/guide/llms-full.txt).

## Steps (play)

- [Step 0 — Content](https://virastack.com/guide/play): Semantic content first
- [Step 1 — Foundation](https://virastack.com/guide/play): React, TypeScript, Next.js, TanStack Start
- [Step 2 — CSS](https://virastack.com/guide/play): Tailwind layout and spacing
- [Step 3 — Typography](https://virastack.com/guide/play): Typeface sets product tone
- [Step 4 — Components](https://virastack.com/guide/play): shadcn/ui + live Mask / Password demos
- [Step 5 — Theme](https://virastack.com/guide/play): Light/dark expectation
- [Step 6 — AI](https://virastack.com/guide/play): Prompt-driven UI moment
- [Step 7 — Finish](https://virastack.com/guide/play): Congratulations + ecosystem CTA

## Related products

- [Start](https://virastack.com/start/llms.txt): Scaffold the stack shown in the guide
- [AI](https://virastack.com/ai/llms.txt): Agent rules kit
- [Mask](https://virastack.com/mask/llms.txt): Input masking demoed in components step
- [Password](https://virastack.com/password/llms.txt): Visibility toggle demoed in components step
- [ViraStack llms.txt](https://virastack.com/llms.txt): Ecosystem map
